changelog: Phase L103 hotfix — HTTP 500 on cart.php and every other L103-gated page. Root cause: no PSR-4 autoloader in the project + gate callsites reference \Cleanmenu\Billing\Features::* class constants BEFORE their local `require partials/tier_paywall.php` runs (which is where Features.php was being loaded). PHP evaluates the class-const reference first → Fatal 'Class not found'. Fix: unconditional `require_once __DIR__ . '/lib/Billing/Features.php'` at the top of session_init.php right after I18n. Features.php is a pure-PHP constants class with zero side effects, safe to eager-load in web/api/sse contexts. Verified locally: cart.php, reservation.php, account.php, customer_orders.php, admin/*, api/* all resolve Features::* references correctly after the eager load.
